review_loop.protocol: /review-2 (two parallel read-only reviewers: bug-hunting debugger; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor) then /address
critical_detail: C1 (flagged independently by BOTH reviewers — corroborated, highest confidence): a denied app that is a BROWSER was still read by the site-origin provider (AXFocusedUIElement + AXURL) and its origin persisted into the lease-governed snapshot artifact, violating the S12 'denied apps never read' absolute; the existing denied test used an unknown-category app and missed the leaking class.

C2 (DB1 critical; CA1's warning corroborated the downstream half): collector state was global, not per-job — a failed identity capture could finalize the PREVIOUS dictation's snapshot into the new job's evidence (field text under the wrong job), and take_downstream read whatever collection a newer dictation had started, misattributing its late context to the job still processing.
warning_detail: envelope context block carried no reason when the destination half was absent
a raising provider was mislabeled 'deadline' with no event; downstream rows marked deadline for providers that were never late
mid-upgrade exception could leave a half-upgraded trio while the event claimed hotkey-down-scope-kept
http(s) page URLs yielded garbage workspaces and forced path_context (both reviewers)
window-title fallback invented origins from version numbers/filenames and its comment contradicted the code
providers read whatever was frontmost at read time — content could be attributed to a cmd-tabbed-away app
test gaps on the critical paths: denied browser, same-app window-change cache sentinel, window-None branch, pid-less fallback, downstream+retention-off
addressed: C1: denied gates on read_site_origin/read_workspace + hard-null values/window-title for denied targets in composition + denied-browser fixture LF-CTX-A9 + test asserting zero host reads and no leak into snapshot/envelope/events.

C2: begin() returns the per-job collection handle (stored on the job); finalize() refuses stale/foreign collections via target_snapshot_id; abandon() on failed identity capture; take_downstream(handle) composes once from the job's own collection (late cleared after composing); the coordinator picks up downstream only via the job's handle.
provider exceptions recorded as provider_failed with a context.provider_failed event; downstream compose marks absent providers not_in_revision.
locals-first scope upgrade (assign job keys only after select succeeds).
is_path_document(): only file:// or scheme-less absolute paths yield workspaces/path_context.
plausible-host check + file-extension denylist for the title fallback; comment aligned.
destination-changed check before any content read (zero reads + destination_changed omissions + event on frontmost drift mid-collection).
all listed test gaps closed (7 new snapshot-suite tests + downstream-retention-off pipeline test); explicit DEADLINE_SLACK_MS constant for the timing assertion.

suggestions: dead symbols removed (OMISSION_UNAVAILABLE/DISABLED, new_target_id/new_context_id, context_snapshot_artifact); _PARTIAL_REASONS built from the omission constants; _steps generator replaced by a plain _collect method; SystemAXHost reuses one systemwide AX element; from_json tolerant round-trip (tuple range, unknown keys); asr_hint_request_fields now called on the real dictation path (job['hint_request_fields']); metadata cache guarded under _active_lock; isinstance guards on raw role/subrole.
deferred: DB1-S6: use a seventh envelope missing-reason value (e.g. retention_disabled) for the training_retain_context knob instead of consent_disabled — deferred because the six-value envelope vocabulary is frozen in contracts/artifacts.md and the precise 'training_context_retention_disabled' reason already lives in the destination block's retention_reason; changing the frozen vocabulary mid-milestone needs its own contract decision.
review_loop.post_address_verification: Every suite re-run green after the fixes (23 fast suites incl. both M06 suites at 27+12 tests, worker_live 2/2, live_pipeline 2/2, cleanup 51/51 at 47.9 s) and the benchmark re-run on post-review code (this file's benchmark_summary).

privacy: Committed artifacts carry synthetic fixtures, hashes and counts only; the envelope's context destination/downstream blocks carry ids, flags, counts and omission reasons — bundle ids, origins, workspace names, window titles and field text live only in the lease-governed snapshot artifacts (pre_decode_context/downstream_context, training lease, independent training_retain_context knob); denied apps and secure fields retain no content anywhere (canary-tested across snapshot JSON, envelope and events); context events are content-free (counts/reasons/durations); the baseline-manifest privacy scan passes over every new path; live data stays under Application Support / Logs, outside the repository.
